note: Hand-written input to scripts/generate_tier_tokens.py. These tables hold what neither vendored source states: AtlasLoot lists each tier token under its boss with no class, and db.json has no row for the tokens at all (the Sunwell tokens 34852/34855/34858 included). `groups` maps the last word of a token name to the class ids (data/proto/common.proto `Class`) that redeem it; each piece's db.json `classAllowlist` must fall inside its token's group, and the generator fails if it does not. `labels` maps each AtlasLoot `T<n>_SET` row comment to this repo's spec slug, or null for a tank or healer set, whose rows go to tank-healer-tokens.json. `tiers` and `slots` read the other two words of a token name: the tier word, and the slot word as a db.json item `type`.
